class.name: YouTube
class.description: Sends score, save data, language, and lifecycle events to the YouTube Playables runtime.

method.name: send_first_frame
method.description: Reports that the first frame has been presented.

method.name: game_ready
method.description: Reports that the game is ready to play.

method.name: save_data
method.description: Saves a string with the YouTube host.

method.name: load_data
method.description: Loads the saved string. The value arrives through [signal result].

method.name: get_language
method.description: Returns the language reported by YouTube.

method.name: is_audio_enabled
method.description: Returns true when YouTube allows game audio.

signal.name: audio_enabled
signal.description: Emitted when YouTube changes the audio permission.

signal.name: result
signal.description: Emitted when a host call returns a payload.
